what: ask 2 / B-51r — what a capture does to the districts' damage pools. SHIZUOKA (Japan, p1) taken by player 0 on turn 112 with one Swordsman. The Encampment's pools were SET to a known 40/100 garrison and 120/200 outer before the capture so any change is visible. Pools read with district:GetDamage/GetMaxDamage(DefenseTypes.DISTRICT_GARRISON|DISTRICT_OUTER) in InGame.

reads: the ENCAMPMENT's own garrison damage RIDES THROUGH the capture unchanged: 40/100 before, 40/100 after. The capture does not zero it and does not heal it.

the CITY CENTRE's garrison pool is NOT zeroed and NOT left at its captured value: it is reset to exactly HALF, 100 of 200 (the city was taken at 200/200 damage, i.e. dead). The captured city comes up at 50% health.

both outer pools (centre AND encampment) read 0/0 after the capture, because the capture DESTROYS the Walls building (walls true -> false). The outer pool does not exist without walls - it is not zeroed, its MAXIMUM is. B-51r's 'zeroes the centre's outer pool' is right in effect; the mechanism is the lost walls, and it takes the ENCAMPMENT's outer pool with it, since the outer maximum is the city's walls level shared by every defending district.
the INCOMPLETE DISTRICT_AQUEDUCT is gone from the captured city's district list entirely; only completed districts survive the capture
population 12 -> 9 on capture (-25%); the city's ID changed from 131073 to 196610, so a capture re-keys the city - never hold a city id across one
the capturing Swordsman took 49 damage taking a city centre already at full garrison damage, and ends standing on the centre tile

what: the capture path that works from the socket, both steps in InGame
note: without PARAM_MODIFIERS the MOVE_TO is accepted and silently never executes. Between step 1 and step 2 the city sits half-captured: owner already 0 but GetDefenseStrength and GetMaxDamage throw. CityDestroyDirectives: LIBERATE_FOUNDER=0 LIBERATE_PREVIOUS_OWNER=1 KEEP=2 RAZE=3 REJECT=4.
